dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: (The notes here are scribbled in from margin to margin, but many lines overlap over each other, making them all difficult to read.)

dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: "...The mechanism here is very tricky. Perhaps some relics of the legendary 'Umibouzu' are buried beneath this place..."

dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: "...If I can obtain them, it would surely be a great discovery in this nation's history. Pity, then, that these Inazumans do not cherish their own past..."

dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: "Next, I'll keep exploring the islands of Inazuma. Hopefully, a workable thesis will emerge before the special documents I got from the Kanjou Commission expire..."
